US Tightens Advanced AI Chip Export Restrictions On China Ahead Of Donald Trump-Xi Jinping Meeting
description: The US has tightened export restrictions on advanced AI chips to prevent China and other embargoed nations from accessing American technology. The move comes ahead of Trump's meeting with Xi Jinping amid internal administration divisions over Nvidia chip exports.

title: Taiwan unveils 2027–2030 tech blueprint to strengthen chip leadership, advance sovereign AI
